Small synthetic CSVs for loader tests. Generated, not copies of user data.

- `semicolon_decimal_comma.csv` — `;` delimiter, `,` decimal mark
- `cp1252_accents.csv` — Windows-1252 encoded (not valid UTF-8)
- `thousands_separator.csv` — quoted `"1,234,567"` numbers
- `junk_header.csv` — header row is `0,1,2,3`
